purpose: Teach: 固く/ちょこっと/ガム/スプーン/風船/古本/はれ/ゴロゴロ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、紙粘土、固くなる前に、形作ろうね。
lines.en: Sho, let's shape this clay before it hardens, okay?
lines.style: Gentle, patient drawl. Hands-on and present. Soft encouraging tone—the kind that makes a child feel capable without being condescended to. Slight upward lilt on 'okay,' inviting collaboration.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん。お菓子、ちょこっとだけ、もらえる、メイ姉さん?
lines.en: Yeah. Can I have just a little bit of candy, Mei-sis?
lines.style: Small hopeful voice, testing gently. The pitch rises on 'candy'—that particular child-negotiation tone. Quick, eager rhythm. Not demanding; genuinely asking permission.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 公園で、ガム、捨てちゃダメよ、ちゃんとゴミ箱にね。
lines.en: At the park, don't just throw gum on the ground—put it in the trash can, okay?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but warm; a practical reminder, not scolding. Steady pace. The firmness of someone who means it but isn't angry. A pause before 'trash can'—giving weight to what matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: スプーン、上手に使えるよ、ぼく。
lines.en: I'm good at using a spoon by myself!
lines.style: Proud, chest-out energy in the voice. Quick bright attack. A child announcing a real achievement—not showing off, just genuinely pleased. Small lift of pride on the closing word.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お祭りで、風船もらえるって、お母さんが言ってたね。
lines.en: Your mom said we'll get balloons at the festival.
lines.style: Warm nostalgia threaded through. Musing, slightly dreamy. The voice of someone sharing something nice a child heard and holding it gently. Soft pace, like she's remembering it with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの本、古本屋で買った絵本、ぼくも見たい。
lines.en: I want to look at that picture book from the used bookstore that you have, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Soft, earnest, slightly shy. The request of a child who admires someone. Steady, unhurried—not demanding, genuinely interested. Tenderness underneath; he's trying to share space with her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 明日、はれるって予報よ、ピクニックね、約束。
lines.en: The forecast says tomorrow will be clear—we promised to go on a picnic!
lines.style: Bright, rising excitement. Quick tempo. The opener lands with anticipation—she's delighted by the promise itself. Slightly breathless on 'picnic,' like she can already see it happening.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 公園の草の上で、ゴロゴロしたい、メイ姉さん!
lines.en: I want to roll around in the grass at the park, Mei-sis!
lines.style: Open, uninhibited joy. Quick attack, full-voiced. The energy of a child who can't contain his happiness. Slight breathless quality—he's picturing it as he speaks. Ending rises with pure excitement.
